connectionFields.name: Environment
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Select Production, Development, or the matching environment type in the form.

connectionFields.name: Atlassian URL
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Site URL such as https://<org>.atlassian.net from the browser.

connectionFields.name: Jira Cloud ID
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Cloud ID from Atlassian admin or Entro's documented lookup for the Jira site.

connectionFields.name: Atlassian Username
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Atlassian account email used to create the API token.

connectionFields.name: Atlassian API Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens; store in the operator vault.

prepSteps.title: Create an Atlassian API token
prepSteps.instruction: Sign in as a Jira admin, create an API token, and note the site URL and Jira Cloud ID.
prepSteps.evidence: id.atlassian.com lists an API token (value stored outside the session) and the Cloud ID is recorded

uncataloged.evidence: id.atlassian.com lists an API token (value stored outside the session) and the Cloud ID is recorded

connectionFields.name: Environment
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Select Production, Development, or the matching environment type in the form.

connectionFields.name: Jira Base URL
connectionFields.obtainedHow: HTTPS URL of the Jira Server reachable from the Connector.

connectionFields.name: Personal Access Token
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Jira Server PAT for a service account; store in the operator vault.

prepSteps.title: Create a Jira Server PAT
prepSteps.instruction: On Jira Server, create a service user with read access and a personal access token; confirm Connector reachability.
prepSteps.evidence: Jira shows the PAT user and the Connector loads the base URL

uncataloged.evidence: Jira shows the PAT user and the Connector loads the base URL
